status: Local design record fixed before running the May-August outcome analysis. Exploratory April was used to develop features, resource regime, and select grid hyperparameters. No external preregistration.
primary: After-reveal, named-link PD-LinUCB acceptance minus LP upper bound for anyone reserving the cost profile before the independently drawn current roster. Bound permits oracle routing within that profile after reveal, future measured availability and a fractional budget. Count per 480 rounds. Strong operational result if lower 95% panel-bootstrap bound exceeds +10.
specific_algorithm: Against each of recency + same dual, posterior means with pacing, tuned fixed prices, simple greedy + same prices, Thompson + same prices, and rolling price LP at the same interface. A claim of a uniquely strong PD-LinUCB edge requires a lower 95% bound over +5 versus the strongest comparison (panel-wise best-of-controls reported too); otherwise name the narrower conclusion.
allocation: 4 collectors (FI, BR, US, UG), 1 single or 1 pair per complete roster. In primary, per 480 slots, up to 120 double reservations, and 96 uses on each of two scarce sites. The two remaining sites have capacity 480; rotate pair of free sites as panel ordinal modulo 4. An attempt is charged even on time-out. The decision is between 10 equally authorized actions.
test: Eight disjoint sets of 16 uniquely sampled probe IDs excluded from April development. Four ordered calendar windows of 120 6-min slots, 24 independent OCP-sampler roster draws per panel, k=3. No trace for a non-registered arm available online. Explicit ping failures and missing measurements map to no timely response in primary; distinguish counts and include missing-data sensitivity. Deadline in ms belongs to {80,130,200}; public seeded independent order. Reward delay 2. Calibration exclusively 2 disjoint April panels and 12 draws.
interpretation: Network replay: first packet of first observed ping per probe and collector in a 6-min slot. Assumes same readiness for simulated concurrent requests, no additional queuing or relay backhaul, fixed grant cost. Verifier requires all selected members on one signed challenge. Identical authenticated roster from any trusted source gives an equal schedule. Never use measured network success to claim OCP consensus improves physical latency.
transport: Four local deterministic OCP ceremony seeds 37101..37104, 48 rounds per policy, N=4 k=2, same authenticated receipt collector implementation and real signed verification, attempt, byte and phase caps. One controlled two-domain workload with a fast receiver for each of two worker groups, fixed before live outcomes. Report as induced protocol validation; run all selected controls. Additional RIPE-shaped trace for a direct end-to-end illustration when feasible.
statistics: 10,000 resamples of the 8 panels with paired Monte Carlo draws retained. Panels share dates and four gateways, so conditional uncertainty only. Do not count the 192 simulations as independent WAN deployments.
